items.title: Global heat records and El Niño place mounting pressure on property insurability
items.summary: Scientists confirm 2026 is on track to be the hottest year on record as climate losses and shrinking carrier appetite reshape property markets.

items.title: UK pet insurance premiums fall despite rising veterinary costs
items.summary: Defaqto data shows average top-five Lifetime pet insurance prices dropped 14% in the year to September despite escalating veterinary treatment expenses.

items.title: Skyward specialty reports 72% rise in Apollo partner fee premium as Lloyd's rates soften
items.summary: Apollo's third-party syndicates drive fee growth for Skyward Specialty while Lloyd's risk-adjusted rates decline.

items.title: UK population growth slows as demographic shifts challenge insurers
items.summary: Official statistics show UK population growth has dropped to 0.3%, prompting life, protection and care insurers to reassess long-term business plans.

items.title: Specialty marine war market lacks depth despite capacity surge, says HIVE CEO
items.summary: Increased funding following Strait of Hormuz disruptions highlights a shortage of specialist marine war underwriting expertise.

items.title: Titanic hull insurance ledger heads to auction in Wiltshire
items.summary: A rare ledger recording Atlantic Mutual's share of the Titanic hull cover is set to be sold by Henry Aldridge & Son with an estimate of up to £50,000.
